_doc: Machine-readable rotation state for the persona bank. persona.json holds IMMUTABLE provenance; this file holds MUTABLE rotation history. Written only by scripts/persona_picker.py commit (atomic tmp+rename). Never hand-edit during a run.

no_face_cycle._doc: every 3rd hero is no-face: one adult + one pack for 200 rows running is the structural tell that rotating the pose cannot reach. Briefly 1 on 2026-08-10 as a safety default after ima2 was measured reproducing the reference person recognisably; restored to 3 the same day when Kevin reaffirmed the 200-face bank. The rights exposure that motivated 1 is real and unresolved — it is recorded in CLAUDE.md and accepted by Kevin, not fixed by this number.

m3039-bl-06.angle_notes: front+chin-down was burned WITHOUT being issued, on 2026-08-13 (seq 29). The hero shipped for that article was rendered against front+level but reads with a slight downward pitch — ima2 QC failed it twice on exactly that, and the level re-roll came back worse (yaw + a duplicated fork), so the dipped frame was the one published. Burning the neighbouring angle keeps the hard rule honest: a later article asking this persona for front+chin-down would have produced a head that reads the same as the live hero.
